shop.chooseTypeHint: Your shop window will open up to match it.

details.title: Your shop window
details.text: It changes with your business type, and your sign shows the names you type.

plan.title: {{name}} · {{type}}
plan.text: Your plan sets how many branches, products and cashiers your shop can have.

review.title: Almost ready
review.text: Create your business, then pay your first invoice to open the doors.

invoice.title: One payment away
invoice.text: The doors open as soon as your payment is confirmed.

waiting.title: Waiting for confirmation
waiting.text: The lights come on once Paymob confirms your payment.

failed.title: Not open yet
failed.text: Return to your invoice whenever you’re ready to pay.

welcome.title: Open for business
welcome.text: Your shop is ready. Add what it sells and make the first sale.

details.title: Let’s set up your *shop.*
details.lead: Just the basics. Pick your business type and watch your shop window come to life.
details.currencyHelp: Vendora works in Egyptian pounds for now.
details.trackText: Track product quantities and stock movements.
details.noTrackText: Manage sales without tracking stock quantities.

errors.nameEn: Enter your business name in English.

plan.title: Choose your *plan.*
plan.lead: Every plan is billed monthly in Egyptian pounds. Pick the one that fits your branches, products and cashiers.
plan.picked: You picked {{plan}} on our website, so it’s selected. You can still change it.
plan.errorText: Check your connection and try again. Your business details are saved.

review.title: Check your *details.*
review.lead: Make sure everything looks right. We’ll create your business when you confirm.
review.errorText: Nothing was lost. Check your connection and try again.
review.calm: This only happens once, so please keep this page open.

invoice.title: Your first *invoice.*
invoice.lead: Your business is created. Pay this invoice on Paymob’s secure checkout to activate your subscription.
invoice.secure: You’ll enter your card details on Paymob’s checkout page, not in Vendora. If you leave before paying, you’ll come back to this invoice.
invoice.errorText: Your business is saved. Try again in a moment.

waiting.title: Checking your *payment…*
waiting.lead: We’re waiting for Paymob to confirm it. This page updates on its own, so there’s no need to pay again.

failed.title: Payment wasn’t *completed.*
failed.lead: The checkout was closed, or the payment didn’t go through. Your invoice is still open, so you can try again.

activating.title: Payment received. *Opening your shop…*
activating.lead: We’re activating your workspace now. You don’t need to pay again.

active.title: You’re *open* for business.
active.lead: Your subscription is active. Let’s get your shop ready for its first sale.

welcome.title: {{name}} is *live.* Now let’s make the first sale.
welcome.lead: A few things to set up, in this order. Do them whenever you’re ready. Each one opens the right screen.
welcome.skip: Skip for now and go to the dashboard

branch.title: Create your first branch
branch.text: Where your shop sells. You need at least one.

terminal.title: Add a checkout terminal
terminal.text: The device your cashiers sell on.

products.title: Add products
products.text: Names and prices of what you sell.

stock.title: Add opening stock
stock.text: How many of each product you have today.

employees.title: Invite employees
employees.text: Give your team their own accounts.

shift.title: Open the first cashier shift
shift.text: Start a shift on your terminal before selling.

sale.title: Make the first sale
sale.text: Ring up your first sale at the checkout.
